notes: The raccoon mask — the one shape that says 'raccoon' rather than 'small brown animal'. v1 was a flattened lens on the front of the face, which from the chase camera's dead-astern view survived as a single purple crescent on one cheek of one head and nothing at all on the other; the geometry in kart.ts is now a band that wraps the sides. Lightened a stop from v1 so the near-black eyes still punch out of it (refs/character/raccoon-artstyle-capycastaway.jpg: hard dark eye against a lighter mask), and kept violet rather than neutral because the palette gate counts near-grey pixels. Brush overlay reduced 0.45 -> 0.18: the painterly direction is abandoned (ART_BIBLE 1) and this was still running at full strength, which is the camouflage mottle on terrain. Brush disabled (0.18 -> 0). At brushScale 0.2 m on a head-sized object the pattern repeats once or twice across the whole surface, which reads as speckle rather than texture — and the painterly direction is abandoned (ART_BIBLE 1).
